description: Write a fact, decision, pattern, preference, error or debt. Recall first: it may exist. A replacement uses supersedes; retire without replacement with crbro_revise; delete with crbro_forget. Repeating a fact merges metadata but NEVER verifies it; confirmations counts mentions, not truth. A value that can change names its source (file, key, URL, person). Explicit source/user checks use crbro_revise status=verified with evidence. reference names a file, URL or person; temporal distinguishes current claims from history. Retired duplicates are refused. Decisions append; preferences stay local. Credentials become markers: crbro_secret them, store only the name. Returns neuron_id, action, shelf_life, near_duplicates and supersedes_unmatched (still live).

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0, default 1.0. Facts only. On an exact-duplicate active fact the stored confidence is updated to this value (updated_in_place:true).

content.description: The knowledge itself. Dense and self-contained: it is recalled without this conversation as context. For a value that can change (a version, price, port, host, setting, who holds a role), say where it came from — the file, config key, URL or person — so a later check knows where to look.

domain.description: Domain, e.g. "proyectos-web". Applied when the neuron is created; on an existing neuron it only replaces the default "general" (crbro_revise domain replaces it unconditionally).

keywords.description: Facts only, and expected on every fact: 2-5 words a future question may use that the text does not contain — synonyms, the other language, the generic name of the product named. Indexed with the fact, never shown; the largest measured lever on recall. Without them the fact is stored and the answer carries keywords_missing. The same text again with new keywords merges them.

keywords_replace.description: When the exact fact text already exists, replace its stored keywords with `keywords` instead of merging (default false). Teammates in a shared space only ever receive the union.

neuron_id.description: Exact neuron id from crbro_recall, e.g. "project_octochat". Skips name matching entirely, and then topic is not needed.

rationale.description: Why the decision was taken. Stored and indexed with it; ignored for other types.

reference.description: Facts only: where to check this claim; a relative file, URL or person, optional field/project. Stored as data, never fetched or executed. No credentials.

shelf_life.description: Facts only: how fast this value goes stale. volatile = versions, prices, ports, hosts, paths, config, who holds a role; durable = rarely moves; permanent = history that cannot change; normal otherwise. Omitted: inferred from the text, and returned.

supersedes.description: Facts this one replaces: their ids or exact text. They leave recall but stay in the file. Unmatched targets are reported and stay live.

temporal.description: Facts only: a claim about current state or a historical record. Historical does not establish what is true now.

topic.description: Topic name, e.g. "OctoChat", "Firebase", "SEO Strategy". Required UNLESS you pass neuron_id, in which case the topic is taken from that neuron.

type.description: error = a mistake plus its correction, in one entry. debt = a deliberate deferral: what was NOT done on purpose, its ceiling, and the revisit condition, e.g. "DEFERRED: protecting the PDFs. CEILING: anyone can download them without signing up. REVISIT WHEN: the signup flow works."
